NOTE: (A) Cost of goods sold includes a provision of $115 million (after-tax $71 million, or $0.25 per share) from the revaluation of the passenger car anti-lock braking systems assets to fair market value.
(B) Represents the gain (after-tax $71 million, or $0.25 per share) on the transfer of the company's high-density polyethylene business to Exxon Chemical Co.
(C) Excludes the one-time impact from the revaluation of the passenger car anti-lock braking systems assets and the transfer of the company's high-density polyethylene business.

(D) Based on weighted average number of shares outstanding during each period: 3 months ended December 31, 1996, 282,848,817 shares and 1995, 282,946,811 shares. There is no material dilutive effect on earnings per share of common stock due to common stock equivalents.

(E) Cost of goods sold includes a second quarter provision of $637 million for repositioning and other charges. An offsetting credit of $15 million representing the minority interest share of repositioning and other charges is included in other income (expense). Total pretax repositioning and other charges were $622 million (after-tax $359 million, or $1.27 per share).
(F) Represents the second quarter gain (after-tax $368 million, or $1.30 per share) on the sale of the hydraulic braking and anti-lock braking systems business effective April 1, 1996.
(G) Excludes the one-time impact from the sale of the hydraulic braking and anti-lock braking systems business as well as from the repositioning and other charges.

(H) Cost of goods sold includes a provision of $115 million (after-tax $71 million, or $0.25 per share) from the revaluation of the passenger car anti-lock braking systems assets to fair market value.
(I) Represents the gain (after-tax $71 million, or $0.25 per share) on the transfer of the company's high-density polyethylene business to Exxon Chemical Co.
(J) Excludes the one-time impact from the revaluation of the passenger car anti-lock braking systems assets and the transfer of the company's high-density polyethylene business.

(K) Based on weighted average number of shares outstanding during each period: 12 months ended December 31, 1996, 282,830,064 shares and 1995, 283,437,773 shares. There is no material dilutive effect on earnings per share of common stock due to common stock equivalents.
